This document 
 outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on 
 an annually bases as 
 indicated by Y1 in the above title block.

The first draft initiated by eng. Safwat Mahrous Masoud, tested by eng. 
 Kamel Tawfeq Gad, accepted by 
 general director eng. Abed El Azem Gomaa Hagras, and 
 approved by eng. Hussein Ahmed El-Mahdy Head Sector of Assuit Power 
 Station. and certified by eng. Gamal Abdel Wahab: UEEPC inspection & quality 
 control Head Sector and MPIS coordinator

A work 
 permit must be issued

The qualified maintenance staff 
 should carry the suitable ID safety category,

Safety fence 
 with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear your safety 
 and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes .... etc

items:
Personnel carrying out 
 the maintenance should be trained and qualified.

Switch off the circuit 
 breaker and be sure that the pressure gauge pointer reads 15 atm.

CB must be isolated and 
 proper earthing at the two sides of the CB is required.

Isolate control circuit 
 (d.c voltage).

Use only fiberglass 
 ladders.

Close the air stopcock 
 in the distributing cabinet.

Open the drainage valve 
 to drain the air out of the tank and be sure that the CB is free of pressure

Maintenance 
 tool kit, screw driver

Safety 
 helmet, and safety shoes

One set of metric open-end box wrenches, one set 
 of socket wrenches, one set of screwdrivers and torque wrench.
Tin cans to hold bolts, washers ..... etc.

Pure alcohol - wipers - fine file and fine emery 
 paper.

Previous periodical maintenance report including 
 ale previous tests and manufacture test certificates.
Complete set of gaskets.
Dismantle the reducing valve
Dismantle push - button device

Clean all parts with 
 pure alcohol and reassemble all parts once again
Dismantle the opening valve and closing valve.
Dismantle tripping and closing electromagnet to clean and maintain them.
Clean all parts with pure alcohol and reassemble all parts once again.
Clean the electrical terminals with flow of air.
Check the safety valve.
Dismantle the cover.
Clean and maintain piston, stem, exhaust valve and non - return valve.
Change the 3 gaskets.

Tighten all nuts of supporting isolator chambers, O-ring chambers by torque 
 wrench with a torque of 1.8 kg m.
Check the accuracy of the pressure gauges.
Close the drainage valve and recharge the CB with air.
Check for any air leakage.

Close and trip the CB two times and be sure that the pressure gauge reads 15 
 atm. when the CB is open and zero atm. when the CB is closed.

Perform micro ohm and timing tests, record the results, compare it with 
 previous test results and report investigate significant changes.
Record all parts that have been changed and test results on maintenance card.

Disconnect the joints between the shunting resistance and arcing chamber to 
 measure the resistance of shunting resistance for the 3 poles.
Disconnect the joints between isolator and capacitors to measure by megger.

Before putting the CB in service clean the CB control cabinet with flow of air 
 then check and tighten all terminals of the terminal block (10 fig 12)
Clean and check all auxiliary contacts.
Check closing and trip coil and their contacts.

Clean and check the air pressure manometer contacts and adjust the air 
 pressure settings as fallowing:
 11 atm for closing 
 12 atm for auto reclosing
Clean and check the auxiliary relays contacts in the CB cabinets.
Check the position indication of the CB.

Before putting the CB in service clean all its metal parts, clean working area 
 and dont forget any wipers on the CB

Record the maintenance that has been done and all parts that have been changed 
 in maintenance card.
Disconnect the parallel joints between the shunting resistance and arc chamber
Measure each resistance.
Reconnect the parallel joints.
Disconnect the parallel joints with isolator chamber
Measure the condenser insulation using megger 2.5kv

Measure the tan delta for condenser (0.5 % at 20: 30 C) w.r.t. temperature 
 factor
Reconnect the parallel joints.

Measure the contact resistance for each phase alone if the value increased, 
 you should measure each insulator or arc chamber alone to determine which 
 chamber has a great value and change the contacts.
The value of each contact for each chamber alone
The value of contact resistance for connectors between isolator and arc.

the following Steps:
